map.由测得值与参考值求相对偏倚: Find relative bias from a measured value and a reference value
map.输入测得值与参考标准值，求相对偏倚。: Enter a measured value and a reference standard value to get the relative bias.
map.📖 查看「由测得值与参考值求相对偏倚 使用指南」: 📖 View Guide: "Find relative bias from a measured value and a reference value"
map.相对偏倚便于跨量程比较。: Relative bias makes comparisons across measuring ranges easy.
map.%bias = bias / 过程变差(或公差) * 100%。例：bias=0: %bias = bias / process variation (or tolerance) x 100%. Example: bias=0.015, process variation 0.1, %bias=15%.
map.Bias%=(20.6−20)/20×100%=3.00%。相对偏倚便于跨量程比: Bias% = (20.6 - 20)/20 x 100% = 3.00%. Relative bias makes cross-range comparison easy; the same absolute bias looks far more severe on a small range.
map.一般 %bias<10% 可接受，具体阈值按行业与风险定。: Generally %bias below 10% is acceptable; the exact threshold depends on the industry and the risk involved.
map.用过程变差或公差需事先约定，两者结论可能不同。: Whether to use process variation or tolerance must be agreed up front, because the two can lead to different conclusions.
